C2_difference_from_C1: frozen V2 surface term disabled (V2 C0 loss)
anchor_control: anchor RGB only, same full-role context-camera-derived bounds; a single view never reaches the >=2-view support, so anchor states are prior-only
only_difference_C0_C1: C1 adds the plane-sweep bypass: 3 non-learned statistics (surface likelihood, free-space likelihood, valid-reference fraction) through a zero-initialized bias-free 3->16 projection added before the fuse_up GELU, plus log_tau (49 parameters). All shared parameters, initialization, the 4096 dense candidates, lifting, fusion, refinement, heads, renderer and bounds are unchanged; at initialization C1 and C0 produce identical states.

plane_sweep.cost: mean over RGB of population variance of reference and valid source colors at 32x40 (area-downsampled views, scaled intrinsics)
plane_sweep.inputs: context RGB, context cameras, TRAIN prior; no depth or query
plane_sweep.voxel_statistics: mean over valid references of D*P(z) and P(depth>z), plus valid-reference fraction; zeros without a valid reference

state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
